FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.title: Backing Track
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Rhythm[/gold] note to your Setlist.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BACKING_TRACK.flavor: A laptop, a click, and a drummer who never asks for a cut of the door.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-CLICK_TRACK.title: Click Track
FLUIDLOVEBAND-CLICK_TRACK.description: At the start of each turn, if your Setlist is empty, add a [gold]Rhythm[/gold] note.
